title: Glister n' Gulp
description: Adds a new way to Eat Melons!
body:
## Overview
**This mod enables the player to consume melons in a fun and new way! Its functions is mainly inspired from the mechanics of eating a sweet cake, with an additional golden treat! ^^**

![Melon Setting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fc2320451a6765f45982dc31a68babbf8618a31_0.webp)
#  
#  
## Melon Block: Now gain hunger when consumed!
![Regular Melon](https://github.com/unknowlence/ModrinthGifs-UNK/blob/main/RegularMelon.gif?raw=true)

## Glister Melon: You will instantly heal your hearts!
**Glistering Melon Slices are now edible and can be used to craft the block below!**

![Glister Melon](https://github.com/unknowlence/ModrinthGifs-UNK/blob/main/GlisteringMelon.gif?raw=true)
